need.engagement: Freelance collaborator network; no employment relationship; autonomous/company invoicing required.
need.continuity_signal: Availability for at least 1-2 projects per month; first scoped project can consolidate into ongoing collaboration.
need.economics_signal: Official page states clients pay well and Boneluv pays collaborators on agreed dates; no numeric contractor rate published.

vds_fit.caveats: Do not claim unsupported numeric PageSpeed results or skills not evidenced in canonical VDS materials.
